en.title: Attendance
en.summary: Who came in and left today, kept by tapping — and every day a scheduled person did not come.

sections.heading: Keeping the register
sections.body:
The register opens on today, grouped by department, with whoever has not come first.

• **In** when someone arrives, **Out** when they leave. No typing: the clinic's clock is stamped (on an earlier day, their scheduled times).
• **Everyone scheduled is in** marks everybody due today, with nothing recorded yet, in at their scheduled start — for a morning when everyone came. Correct anyone who was late afterwards.
• **Times** corrects a time; **Undo** clears the day.
• **Excused** records an absence with its reason — a sick note, a clinic errand. It is not deducted.

Use the arrows or Today to keep an earlier day.

sections.heading: What counts as absent
sections.body:
A day the person is scheduled to work (their schedule on the employee profile) with nothing recorded is an **absence**, and payroll deducts it — a thirtieth of the month's basic pay. Approved leave, a clinic closure and an excused day are not absences; neither is a day off.

Today is 'Not in yet' until it is over. Days before the branch started keeping this register, and before someone was hired, are not counted.

Arriving late and leaving early are shown in minutes against the schedule, and never deducted.

sections.heading: The month
sections.body:
**Month** shows everyone down the side and every day of an Ethiopian month across: P present, A absent, E excused, L leave, C clinic closed. Red is what payroll will deduct. Click a day to open its register and correct it.

The unpaid salaries page lists anyone with unrecorded working days before you pay, so a forgotten tick is caught there. A day in a month already paid can no longer be changed.

am.title: መገኘት
am.summary: ዛሬ ማን እንደገባና እንደወጣ፣ በመጫን ብቻ — እና ፕሮግራም ያለው ሰው ያልመጣባቸው ቀናት ሁሉ።

sections.heading: መዝገቡን መያዝ
sections.body:
መዝገቡ በዛሬው ቀን በክፍል ተከፋፍሎ ይከፈታል፤ ገና ያልመጡት በመጀመሪያ።

• አንድ ሰው ሲደርስ **ገባ**፣ ሲወጣ **ወጣ** ይጫኑ። መጻፍ አያስፈልግም፤ የክሊኒኩ ሰዓት ይመዘገባል።
• **ፕሮግራም ያላቸው ሁሉ ገብተዋል** ሁሉንም በፕሮግራማቸው መጀመሪያ ሰዓት ያስገባል።
• **ሰዓት** ሰዓትን ያርማል፤ **መልስ** ቀኑን ያጠፋል።
• **ፈቃድ ያለው** ቀሪነትን ከምክንያቱ ጋር ይመዘግባል፤ አይቀነስም።

sections.heading: ቀሪ የሚባለው
sections.body:
ሰውየው እንዲሠራ ፕሮግራም የተያዘለትና ምንም ያልተመዘገበበት ቀን **ቀሪ** ነው፤ ደመወዝ ይቀንሰዋል — የወሩ መሠረታዊ ደመወዝ አንድ ሠላሳኛ። የጸደቀ ፈቃድ፣ የክሊኒክ መዘጋትና በምክንያት የተፈቀደ ቀን ቀሪ አይደሉም።

ማርፈድና ቀድሞ መውጣት በደቂቃ ይታያሉ፤ አይቀነሱም።

sections.heading: ወሩ
sections.body: **ወር** ሁሉንም ሰው በአንድ የኢትዮጵያ ወር ቀናት ያሳያል፦ P ተገኝቷል፣ A ቀሪ፣ E ተፈቅዷል፣ L ፈቃድ፣ C ክሊኒኩ ተዘግቷል። ቀይ ደመወዝ የሚቀንሰው ነው። ቀኑን ለማረም ይጫኑት።
